echo "[2]语法:"; python3 -m py_compile /root/music_sign_v7.py && echo OK || echo 错
echo "[3]备份v6:"; cp -f /root/music_sign.py /root/music_sign_v6.bak && echo 已备份
echo "[4]覆盖运行路径:"; cp -f /root/music_sign_v7.py /root/music_sign.py && md5sum /root/music_sign.py

echo "[7]真机验收(只传id,看musicUrl是否真mp3):"
python3 -c '
import json,urllib.request
req=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:10800/",data=json.dumps({"type":"163","id":"33737547"}).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
c=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=25).read().decode())
m=c.get("meta",{}).get("music",{})
print("tag=%s title=%r"%(m.get("tag"),m.get("title")))
print("musicUrl=%s"%m.get("musicUrl"))
print("jumpUrl=%s"%m.get("jumpUrl"))
print("token=%s"%bool((c.get("config") or {}).get("token")))
'
